I will put two bags of NPK fertilizer on this my rice plot because last season I did the same and the yield was better than when I used none. I do not have manure to carry here — what little my goats leave goes to the vegetable garden near the house, not this far plot. I will plant the rice seed I kept from last year; I do not know these new seeds they sell in town and I will not risk my money on what I have not seen grow. I will buy one small bottle of herbicide to spray the weeds because weeding by hand takes too many days and my children have school now. This plot depends on rain; I have no pump and no money for one. My wife and I will do most of the work with my older sons — we will spend about 60 days on this plot from clearing to harvest. I will hire five laborers for one day each when the rice is ready to cut because the birds will not wait and my family alone cannot finish quickly.
